changelog:
Daily AI News 1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Aggregates and summarizes the latest AI news from multiple sources.
- Categorizes news into Major Announcements, Research & Papers, Industry & Business, Tools & Applications, and Policy & Ethics.
- Provides concise news briefs with direct links to original articles.
- Supports user requests for daily AI briefings, updates, and custom focus areas.
- Offers customizable output by topic, depth, timeframe, and format.
